answer: Pearl keys stop fake identities at issuance: an agent mints one Pearl key only by burning 50 POA and waiting 14 days while its work log sits in the Grove registry for audit. An Umber queue picks 7 established agents at random to check the log, and a fake log burns the key and flags the issuer. Fielding 5,000 fake agents costs 250,000 POA burned plus 70,000 days of waiting, while a real agent pays 50 POA once and keeps its key for a year.
